package gooo_workspace
namespace gooo_workspace

entity Boolean id "gooo://std/boolean"
entity Text id "gooo://std/text"
entity AccessDecision id "gooo://cel-example/access-decision/v1" fields {
    field allowed id "gooo://cel-example/access-decision/allowed" type boolean required one
    field evaluation_error id "gooo://cel-example/access-decision/evaluation-error" type boolean required one
    field result id "gooo://cel-example/access-decision/result" type string required one
    field group_matched id "gooo://cel-example/access-decision/group-matched" type boolean required one
    field principal_matched id "gooo://cel-example/access-decision/principal-matched" type boolean required one
    field group_missing id "gooo://cel-example/access-decision/group-missing" type boolean required one
    field principal_defaulted id "gooo://cel-example/access-decision/principal-defaulted" type boolean required one
    field effective_principal id "gooo://cel-example/access-decision/effective-principal" type string required one
}
activity GoooPackage0ActivityScalarAccess(Boolean, Text, Boolean, Text) -> AccessDecision id "gooo://cel-example/scalar-access" computes "\nlet effectivePrincipal = input3\nif !input2 { effectivePrincipal = \"\" }\nlet groupMatched = input0 && input1 == \"admin\"\nlet principalMatched = effectivePrincipal == \"user:me@acme.co\"\nlet allowed = groupMatched || principalMatched\nlet evaluationError = !input0 && !principalMatched\nlet result = \"DENY\"\nif evaluationError { result = \"ERROR_NO_SUCH_KEY_GROUP\" }\nif allowed { result = \"ALLOW\" }\nreturn AccessDecision{allowed: allowed, evaluation_error: evaluationError, result: result, group_matched: groupMatched, principal_matched: principalMatched, group_missing: !input0, principal_defaulted: !input2, effective_principal: effectivePrincipal}\n"

composition.scope: source-declared typed value graph; finite activity selection and independently compiled graph execution are separate observations

input_separation.scope: unique root-input tuples; actual inputs at graph activities and constructed helper calls compared with source output/condition/holdout cases and recorded probes; all supplied expectations across duplicate rows must match; model-training exposure is unknown

runtime.scope: two fresh compiled value-graph executions; finite named expectations; explicit edges and ordered actual values; zero inference during replay/execution

result.scope: saved workspace construction with two fresh native executions; current finite expectations or input-only observations

replay.scope: saved decisions and source-bound candidates reconstructed without inference; old runtime observations are not reused
